::: {.panel-tabset}

### Arctic Ocean

```{r, t_data_resource_arc, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

df_tbl <- tibble(`Code` = c("AR", "GL", "CORA"),
                 `Filename` = c("nrt_ar_ar.parquet",
                                "nrt_ar_gl.parquet",
                                "cora_ar.parquet"),
                 Size = c("583.00 MB", "328.49 MB", "828.37 MB"),
                 `# Platforms` = c(191, 538, 747),
                 `# Profiles` = c(295156, 173481, 412867),
                 `# Observations` = c(79134055, 50392172, 117998376))

kbl_table(df_tbl) %>% kable_styling(font_size = 12)

```
